summary_en: 750,000 shares (3.31% of 22,675,222 ex-treasury), ¥400M ceiling. Execution window Sep 1, 2026 – May 31, 2027. Method: ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchases. Rationale: flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Pertaining to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On August 28, 2026, TONE Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard: 5967) announced the board's authorization to acquire up to 750,000 shares of its own common stock, representing 3.31% of the 22,675,222 shares outstanding (excluding treasury), for a maximum of ¥400 million. The acquisition will be conducted from September 1, 2026, through May 31, 2027, using open-market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange automated trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange). The company states that execution of the full program is not guaranteed and may be curtailed or omitted depending on market conditions. The stated purpose is to enable flexible capital policy in response to shifts in the business environment.
